title: Bounded acyclic and flat models for a compactified etale morphism
statement:
Let $e:U	o V$ be a separated etale morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes (schemes with finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings), and choose a compactification $U\xrightarrow jW\xrightarrow rV$, with $j$ open and $r$ proper [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring and let $K$ be a cochain complex of constant-$R$ module sheaves on $U_{m et}$, with $K^n=0$ for $n$ outside a fixed finite interval $[a,b]$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Use the ordinary module derived categories with localization $Q$, exact extension by zero $j_!$, direct image $r_*$, and exact sum extension $e_{\Sigma!}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. Then $W$ is Noetherian and
$$R^q r_{*,R}(j_!K^n)=0\quad(n\in\mathbf Z,\ q>0).$$
The canonical acyclic-complex comparison $\alpha_K:Q(r_*j_!K)	o Rr_*Q(j_!K)$ is an isomorphism. Let $c_K:Rr_*Q(j_!K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(e_{\Sigma!}K)$ be the prescribed compact-support normalization of [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization], and let $
u_M:r_*j_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}e_{\Sigma!}M$ be its degree-zero comparison for a module sheaf $M$, sending a proper-support section to its etale sheet components. The maps $
u_{K^n}$ form a chain isomorphism $
u_K:r_*j_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}e_{\Sigma!}K$, and $c_K\alpha_K=Q(
u_K)$. These comparisons are natural in chain maps. The complexes $j_!K$, $r_*j_!K$ and $e_{\Sigma!}K$ vanish outside $[a,b]$. If every $K^n$ is flat (tensoring with it preserves exact sequences), then these three complexes have flat terms, and they and $K$ are K-flat (their total tensor with any acyclic complex is acyclic) [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] [def-pc-kflat-complex]. No flatness assumption is needed for the preceding acyclicity and canonical comparison assertions.

proof.text: Properness of c.g gives finite type and quasi-compactness. Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace give the two fields of IsNoetherian c.Z. The module-sheaf categories already carry the required Grothendieck and injective-resolution instances.

For the given normalization N, its derived_normalization equation at M[0] expresses its invertible derived comparison as the localized termwise sheafComparison followed by the right-derived unit. By lem-kun-right-derived-single-h0 the zeroth homology of this unit is invertible, since lowerStar is left exact. Naturality with the termwise-single isomorphism transfers this assertion to the open extension of M[0]. Cancel the invertible factors, use homologyFunctorFactorsh and homologyFunctorFactors to return to the chain-level homology map, and then arrowIsoHomologyMapMapHomologicalComplexSingle to reflect invertibility to sheafComparison.app M. Componentwise invertibility makes a=N.sheafComparison e c invertible. Set nu=(asIso a).symm, whose inverse is exactly a. The Lean proof reuses the existing proved private supportSheafIso from EtaleSupportMapCompatibility, imported with import all, rather than copying this generic zeroth-homology argument.

For M=K.X n, compose the inverse exact/single comparison for open extension, the given N.comparison at M[0], and the exact/single comparison for etale sum extension. This identifies Rr_*((j_!M)[0]) with (e_!M)[0]. Positive homology of the latter is zero. The unbounded/Plus compatibility and homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso identify the former homology with R^q r_*(j_!M), giving the claimed vanishing.

Translate derived_normalization from a homotopy representative of L to QL using the existing proved private comparison_complex_fac in UnboundedEtaleCompactSupportComparisons, imported with import all. Its right_unit_Q is definitionally the existing public rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ. This gives D(e_!).factors.hom_L followed by Q(a_L) followed by alpha_L equals N.comparison.inv_QL. Since the first two arrows are invertible, alpha_L is invertible. Precompose the desired c alpha=Q(nu) identity by the invertible D(e_!).factors.hom_K followed by Q(a_K). The preceding equation, N.comparison.inv_hom_id and Q(a_K)Q(nu_K)=1 prove it. Naturality follows from rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ_naturality and the naturality of the exact open-extension factorization; the private proved acyclicComparison_naturality states this calculation for abstract functors before application to scheme functors. This uses only the generic categorical helper from the imported module; it does not invoke or bypass any geometric comparison theorem. The private proved comparison_cancel packages the final cancellation for arbitrary isomorphisms, so the scheme specialization applies that lemma without expanding its functors.

For any degree outside [a,b], map the supplied zero object K.X n through the additive open-extension, direct-image and etale sum-extension functors. These are the actual terms of the degreewise image complexes, so the same interval bounds apply.

Use the braiding to turn exactness of tensorRight(K.X n) into categorical two-sided flatness. The proved preservesFlat_etaleLowerShriek instance follows from the natural projection isomorphism tensorLeftEtaleLowerShriekIso and exactness of inverse image and sum extension; apply it both to c.i (definitionally open extension) and e. Transport the latter flatness across nu.app(K.X n) to obtain flatness of r_*j_!K.X n. Convert each upper support bound b into IsStrictlyLE b and apply the existing general categorical bounded-above flat K-flat criterion directly to all four complexes. Tensor preserves the needed colimits, and the sheaf category has exact filtered colimits by its existing Grothendieck instances.
